correctness.rationale: The finite perturbation changes the counting measure N(U) by a constant once U exceeds the altered prime logs, so the integral of N(t)/t changes by Delta C log U plus the exact sum of log-log prime constants. The full Vernaeve–Vindas–Weiermann Corollary 1 was inspected: when C changes by Delta, the partition asymptotic is multiplied by kappa_m^{-Delta} U^{Delta/2}, and equation (3.3) shows a constant D-shift enters exponentially. Substitution gives exactly the record's product of log p factors and kappa powers. For dependent indices, {ua+vb} is a numerical semigroup with finitely many gaps and genus (u-1)(v-1)/2; the deposited exact script reproduces the example gap sets and constants.

originality.rationale: The final theorem is already mechanically implied by the 2014 general asymptotic theorem. Corollary 1 explicitly describes how the asymptotic changes under exactly the C and D coefficient shifts produced by adding or deleting finitely many prime generators. The dependent (r,s) case then reduces to deleting the finite gap set of the classical two-generator numerical semigroup. Under the audit rule that corollaries and special cases count as covered, absence of this wording in Golafshan's multiplicatively-independent paper does not create originality.
